  PROBLEM: Path validation and the pathname-based open are separated by a TOCTOU window in which a same-uid process can replace an intermediate directory with a symlink, redirecting the open outside the scratchpad.
  WHY: O_NOFOLLOW protects only the final component, so a redirected same-uid-owned regular file can pass the subsequent fstat checks and have its contents published as a comment under the caller's credentials.
